panels.description: NIC utilization vs per-core bandwidth baseline (Tencent CVM: 48MB/core, or 96MB if <=2 cores; packet budget 9w/15w).

targets.source:
# 1. 计算分子：(网络接收速率 + 网络发送速率) * 100
 (
    (
      max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id,instance_role) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_recv{shard=~"$shard",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", device_name="eth1", instance_role=~"$instance_role"}[1m]))
      +
      max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id,instance_role) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_sent{shard=~"$shard",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", device_name="eth1", instance_role=~"$instance_role"}[1m]))
    ) * 100
  )
  /
  # 2. 计算分母：(去重后的核心数 * 对应基准带宽)
  (
    # 逻辑 A：核心数 <= 2，用 96M 基准
    (
      count by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id,instance_role) (group by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id, device_name,instance_role) (bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{shard=~"$shard",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", instance_role=~"$instance_role"})) <= 2
    ) * (96 * 1024 * 1024)
    or
    # 逻辑 B：核心数 > 2，用 48M 基准
    (
      count by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id,instance_role) (group by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id, device_name,instance_role) (bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{shard=~"$shard",cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", instance_role=~"$instance_role"})) > 2
    ) * (48 * 1024 * 1024)
  )
